facts.hours: March 2 - May 31: Tuesday - Friday 10am - 4pm, Saturday - Sunday 10am - 5pm; June 1 - September 13: Daily 9am - 6pm; September 14 - November 30: Tuesday - Friday 9am - 4pm, Saturday - Sunday 9am - 6pm (November 26 Closed); December 1 - March 1: Wednesday - Sunday 9am - 4pm (December 25 Closed, January 1 Closed)
facts.prices: Adults (13+): $26; Youth (3–12): $16; Children (Under 3): Free. Discounts are available for seniors, active duty and military veterans, college students, and groups of 15+.
facts.visit_length: about three and a half hours to explore the exhibition. If you’d like to walk the one-mile boardwalk, allow extra time.

task_check.biggest_fix: Add clear parking instructions to the Directions section and cut the overwhelming directory of regional links at the bottom.
